summary: round 2, delta since 78f056a: F-1, F-2, F-3, F-4, F-5 fixed (REQ-CMP-001 AC-1..AC-3 with P6; REQ-SMK-001 AC-2, AC-3 with P2; REQ-DOC-001 AC-2 and REQ-DOC-003 AC-5; REQ-CMP-007 AC-2, AC-3; REQ-SMK-001 AC-6, AC-7 with P5). Minors F-6 to F-16 and info F-20 also fixed. No blocker or major. Proposed items: none needs a requester question; P6 relaxes the literal Q11 wording and the approver should confirm it knowingly (F-25). Follow-ups: 3 new minor, 2 new info, 3 carried info (F-17, F-18, F-19).

findings.message: The front matter upstream list is empty, while CHG-0001 requirements listed its input (intent.md with its sha256). This file input is clarifications.md.
findings.suggestion: List .harness/changes/CHG-0005/clarifications.md as upstream if the harness supports it.

findings.message: D3 keeps README.md, .env.example and docker-compose.yml at the root, and CHG-0001 deferred NFR-002 AC-1 because no node could own root files (conformance.md L153). Nothing yet assigns them to a node.
findings.suggestion: Make sure the plan gives one node the root files (and .gitignore, if F-10 is taken) before the build phase.

findings.message: For the SDD: the build contexts should exclude api/data (the person SQLite file), api/target and web/node_modules, the API healthcheck needs an HTTP client in the JRE image or another probe, and a non-root nginx cannot listen on port 80.
findings.suggestion: Settle these in the SDD under REQ-CMP-001, REQ-CMP-005 and NFR-102.

findings.message: REQ-SMK-001 AC-7 does not match the ACs it should record. Its Given is the Compose stack and the glossary defines UAT as Compose-only, yet it lists REQ-DOC-001 AC-1 (the native run). It omits REQ-CMP-002 AC-1 and REQ-CMP-007 AC-1, which the file says are verified by the UAT. The runs of REQ-CMP-003 AC-4 (curl by the person or agents) and the REQ-CMP-005 AC-3 trial have no record either.
findings.suggestion: List every AC verified by the person or by a manual trial (REQ-DOC-001 AC-1 as a native-run step, REQ-CMP-002 AC-1, REQ-CMP-007 AC-1, REQ-CMP-003 AC-4, REQ-CMP-005 AC-3), or widen the glossary UAT entry to cover the native run.

findings.message: REQ-DOC-003 AC-5 says pnpm -C web e2e starts its own SPA, but web/playwright.config.ts L35-L42 reuses a server already on 5173 outside CI (reuseExistingServer). It quotes the error as "port 8080 is already in use"; web/e2e/support/api-process.ts L33 says "Port 8080 is already in use; stop the other API first". The required README advice (stop the native run and the Compose stack first) stays right.
findings.suggestion: Say the e2e starts its own API and starts or reuses a server on 5173, and quote the message exactly or paraphrase it without quotes.

findings.message: The note that each NFR is a cross-reference to the AC it names is not true for NFR-106 and NFR-107, which name no other AC and need their own proof. NFR-101, NFR-102 and NFR-104 also add clauses beyond the AC they cite (no other port published; no credential in a build argument; no file configures a registry).
findings.suggestion: Limit the note to NFR-101 to NFR-105, and say that their extra clauses are checked by inspection under the NFR ID.

findings.message: NFR-106 is measured from the healthcheck status times in docker compose ps, but ps shows only the current status, not when it changed, and REQ-SMK-001 AC-6 does not ask the record to include the measured time.
findings.suggestion: Measure with docker compose events or the health log of docker inspect, and add the measured time to the AC-6 record.

findings.message: P6 reads the Q11 answer (Major/minor tags) as at least the major line and states that minor-version pinning is not required. The reading fits every image Q11 (a) names (eclipse-temurin:21-jdk, nginx:stable-alpine), so no requester question is needed, but it departs from the literal answer. P2 (tightened), P5 and P7 are analyst proposals within the answers and are fit for confirmation at freeze.
findings.suggestion: At the freeze, the approver confirms P6 explicitly as a reading of Q11, not a restatement of it.
